reason: Compares DAPK1 promoter methylation between breast tumor and paired normal tissue in 128 patients, linking methylation to clinicopathological features as a candidate diagnostic/prognostic marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K array) is compared in obese vs non-obese children's blood in a cohort, relating methylation to the obesity outcome.
The only marker actually measured in human prostate epithelium is piRNA (non-coding RNA); the VDR ChIP-seq assesses transcription-factor binding sites, not DNA methylation or histone modification.
OGDHL promoter methylation is measured by qMSP in paired tumor/adjacent-normal tissue from 40 colorectal cancer patients and evaluated as a diagnostic biomarker via ROC analysis.
Global DNA methylation (5-mC%) is measured in blood of stunted vs non-stunted children and related to dietary intake, a modifiable exposure.
Case-control methylation profiling (autism/schizophrenia cohorts vs population controls) identifies rare epivariations as potential disease-risk markers.
Study measures sperm aneuploidy (FISH), whole-exome sequencing, and gene expression (RNA-seq) in infertile men; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is reported.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is compared in placenta of VSD-affected vs unaffected term infants, proposed as a detection biomarker for a congenital heart defect.
IL12B CpG-island methylation is measured and compared between 99 ankylosing spondylitis patients and 99 healthy controls, evaluated by ROC for diagnostic discrimination.
DNAm age (epigenetic clock) is computed from genome-wide methylation in a small case-control aging pilot study and correlated with behavioral/health measures.
CpG methylation at four sites is correlated with GDF11 expression and overall survival using primary and TCGA-UVM individual-level data in uveal melanoma.
Compares decitabine (a hypomethylating agent) with intensive chemotherapy in elderly AML by clinical outcomes only; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker was measured.
DRD2 promoter methylation is measured by pyrosequencing in high- vs low-familial-risk offspring, linked to brain structure as a risk-stratification marker for alcohol dependence.
Study examines a DNMT3L coding variant, vitamin B intake, cognition and in-silico protein modeling; DNA methylation itself is not reported as measured in participants.
Abstract attributes reduced gene expression in CD8+ T cells to 'histone deacetylation' without stating that a histone modification or chromatin assay was actually performed.
SDC2 stool-DNA methylation test is evaluated for sensitivity/specificity in a large prospective colorectal cancer screening cohort with clinical trial registration.
DNA methylation profiling classifies 27 astroblastoma cases into molecular subgroups that differ significantly in overall survival, a prognostic cohort design.
Presents the bigmelon R software package for large-scale methylation-data analysis; this is a technical/bioinformatics tool paper, not a human evaluation study.
Genome-wide DNA methylation is compared between FASD cases and controls across discovery and replication cohorts to identify diagnostic/prognostic loci.
TP53 promoter methylation is assessed by methylation-specific PCR alongside mutation analysis in 74 DLBCL patients, contributing to prognostic characterization of the cohort.
Promoter methylation of CDKN2A/APC/MLH1 and LINE-1 is measured in blood of construction workers versus unexposed workers, linking methylation to an occupational/environmental exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation is compared between newborns with orofacial clefts and controls, linked to periconceptional folic-acid exposure as the modifiable factor.
Study genotypes PHLDB1 SNPs in a case-control design; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark is measured, only a bioinformatic prediction that one SNP overlaps a CpG site.
H3 K27M is detected as a genetic mutation by immunohistochemistry for the mutant histone protein, not as a measured histone modification/chromatin mark.
Epigenome-wide methylation study identifies and pyrosequencing-validates CpG sites discriminating Behcet's disease patients from controls as diagnostic markers.
DNA methylation array is included in multi-omics profiling of matched diagnosis-relapse BCP-ALL samples (cohort design) to characterize relapse-specific molecular alterations.
Neoadjuvant soy isoflavone trial measures LINE-1 methylation change by pyrosequencing in HNSCC patients, a non-randomised interventional design linking methylation to a modifiable intervention.
Precision-medicine trial for DIPG relies on whole-exome/RNA sequencing and ctDNA H3K27M mutation detection; no epigenetic mark (methylation or histone modification) is directly measured.
Methylation profiling (EPIC array) compares 18 high-myopia cases with 18 matched controls, an eligible case-control design directly measuring DNA methylation.
SOX12 study measures gene/protein expression and metabolic pathway activity in colorectal cancer; no DNA methylation or histone modification is assayed.
The only marker measured is lincRNA-p21, a long non-coding RNA, with no DNA methylation or histone modification assay reported.
HDAC-inhibitor belinostat is evaluated by MRI/clinical outcome in a small human pilot alongside animal experiments; no histone acetylation or other epigenetic marker was measured in patients.

Abstract does not specify whether CpG island methylator phenotype status was itself measured by this study or only cited as an existing TCGA annotation alongside the gene-expression classifier that is the actual focus.

A new SFRP2 MethyLight assay measures promoter methylation in paired tumor/paracancer tissue and serum from colorectal cancer patients versus normal individuals, assessed for screening sensitivity/specificity.
Phase II trial of a tumor-cell vaccine with CpG-B adjuvant and IFN-alpha assesses immune activation and clinical response; CpG-B is a therapeutic oligonucleotide, not a measured epigenetic marker.
Methylation at two CpG sites is examined against LGALS3 expression and survival using online (TCGA-derived) individual-level glioblastoma data, a secondary-analysis prognostic design.
Single-patient case report of a novel NUP98-LEDGF AML rearrangement monitored by RT-PCR; a case report is excluded regardless of the epigenetic background discussion.
HOXA9 promoter methylation is measured by qMSP in 145 paired HNSCC/normal tissue plus TCGA validation, evaluated for diagnostic value (AUC).
A DNA-methylation-based epigenetic BMI score is derived and tested in the Lothian Birth Cohort against health outcomes, linking methylation to the modifiable BMI/obesity exposure.
Prospective screening study tests a blood DNA-hypermethylation biomarker (Colvera, BCAT1/IKZF1) alongside FIT for detecting colorectal precursor lesions.

Core classifier for medulloblastoma subgrouping is gene-expression-based (TLDA); methylation array is used mainly as an existing reference/validation standard, so it is unclear whether DNA methylation is the marker being evaluated for the clinical decision.
In-vivo HDAC-inhibitor trial in HIV+ individuals assesses NK-cell phenotype and function; no histone acetylation or other epigenetic marker is measured as an outcome.
Blood DNA methylome (450K) is compared between AUD and healthy control subjects and correlated with insular surface area, a case-control design directly measuring methylation.
Whole-blood methylation of VIM/CXCR4/DOK7/SPDEF genes is measured and compared between 60 breast cancer patients and 40 healthy controls as diagnostic/prognostic biomarkers.
Genome-wide promoter methylation is compared in skeletal muscle of lifelong physically active versus sedentary aged men, linking methylation to the modifiable exercise exposure.
H3 and H4 histone acetylation are measured by ChIP in 173 term placentas and linked to maternal olive oil and fish intake, modifiable dietary exposures.
DNA methylation at 30 breast-cancer genes is measured in blood of daughters with prenatal DDT exposure data in a prospective cohort, linking methylation to the DDT exposure.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is measured in blood and linked to long-term ambient air pollution (PM10, NO2) exposure in a Korean adult cohort.
Three epigenetic-clock measures are computed from methylation data in a TILDA sub-sample and compared with allostatic load as candidate biological-embedding mechanisms for socioeconomic position.
CHST7 methylation is measured in white blood cells and associated with colorectal cancer risk, validated in an independent GEO dataset, proposed as a risk biomarker.
MTHFD1 promoter methylation is measured by qMSP and compared between hypertensive stroke cases and hypertensive controls, with diagnostic AUC/sensitivity/specificity reported.
Children's Oncology Group ependymoma trial uses DNA methylation profiles to classify posterior fossa molecular subgroups and relates this classification to event-free survival.
NR3C1 promoter methylation is measured in postmortem brain of physically abused versus non-abused children, linking methylation to the early-life-stress exposure.
PDCD1 promoter methylation is measured and compared between 206 rheumatoid arthritis patients and 234 controls alongside expression and genotype data.
Whole-exome sequencing is performed on established multiple myeloma cell lines and EBV-immortalized B-cell lines; this is an in-vitro cell-line study with no primary patient samples analyzed.

Randomized controlled trial in children with cow's milk allergy measures FoxP3 and cytokine gene methylation before/after two dietary interventions, directly linking methylation to a modifiable treatment.
Genome-wide and exome-wide association studies identify NUDT15/TPMT genetic variants linked to thiopurine myelosuppression; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker is measured.
Targeted bisulfite sequencing measures DNA methylation in cardiac tissue across heart-failure subtypes versus non-failing controls, proposed as a diagnostic/therapeutic target.
DNA methylation and H3K27ac/H3K4me3 histone modification changes at the DLEU1 locus are measured using TCGA and cohort tumor data and linked to cancer prognosis.
Blood DNA methylome is measured in non-atopic asthma cases versus controls from the SAPALDIA cohort, examining effect modification by BMI, a modifiable exposure.
MGMT-unmethylated status is used only as a cohort inclusion criterion; the study's actual analysis relates postoperative tumor volume, not methylation, to survival.
DNA methylation data (secondary analysis of ICGC/TCGA individual-level data) is compared between mucinous and ductal breast cancer to identify MUC2 methylation as a subtype-distinguishing mechanism.

DNA methylation array profiling is used as a diagnostic classifier for adult brain tumors across roughly 1550 patients, changing or refining the histological diagnosis in the majority of referred cases.
MGMT promoter methylation is measured by HRM and compared between lung cancer cases and controls, linked to lung cancer risk in a case-control design.
Cohort study of wartime parental separation and later work-career outcomes; no epigenetic marker is measured, only administrative pension/employment records.
Blood DNA methylation (850K) is measured in pediatric Crohn's disease patients versus controls at diagnosis and follow-up, linked to disease progression and treatment response.
Urinary DNA methylation (CRIP3) combined with miRNA is measured in prostate cancer patients on active surveillance to predict reclassification, a monitoring application.
Randomized controlled trial of folic acid supplementation in pregnancy measures epigenome-wide and pyrosequencing-validated DNA methylation changes at ZFP57 in cord blood.
Phase 2 trial of eltrombopag in hypomethylating-agent-failure MDS reports platelet/survival outcomes only; DNA methylation itself is not measured in this study.
FHIT and p16 promoter methylation is measured by MSP and compared between liver cancer patients and non-hepatoma controls as an independent risk factor.
p66shc promoter hypomethylation is reported as associated with flow-mediated dilation in human coronary artery disease patients versus healthy controls, alongside the primary mouse mechanistic work.

NAC-supplementation trial in infertile men measures sperm chromatin integrity (protamine/CMA3, TUNEL DNA fragmentation), which the instrument specifies as DNA damage/packaging assays, not epigenetic marks.
Genome-wide leukocyte DNA methylation is measured in a Philippines cohort and associated with socioeconomic status across development, an exposure-linked cross-sectional design.
A polyepigenetic DNA methylation score for smoking is validated longitudinally in two birth cohorts, directly linking methylation to the modifiable smoking exposure.
G0S2 promoter methylation is measured by qPCR/bisulfite sequencing in an independent cohort of adrenocortical tumors, explicitly proposed for routine clinical decision-making.
Posterior fossa ependymoma subgroups are assigned by genome-wide methylation array and H3K27me3 immunoreactivity, then related to long-term survival and neurocognitive outcomes.
Methylation data (from GEO/TCGA individual-level datasets) is analyzed to show hypomethylation drives SLC6A6 overexpression, linked to gastric cancer prognosis.

DNA methylation and H3K27me3 histone methylation are described as regulating tumor-suppressor lncRNAs, but the abstract does not make clear whether these marks were measured directly in patient tissue or only in the in-vitro mechanistic experiments for the single validated gene.
Randomized, double-blind, repeated-measures trial measures global and gene-specific (PPARGC1A, IL6) DNA methylation in leukocytes before/after aerobic exercise and fatty-acid supplementation.
Longitudinal epigenome-wide DNA methylation is measured in blood of African American cohort participants and linked to smoking status, a modifiable exposure.
Phase 2 trial of pracinostat (an HDAC inhibitor) plus azacitidine in AML reports clinical response and somatic mutation clearance; histone acetylation or methylation is not measured as an outcome.
DNA methylation array profiling of 28 brain tumors identifies a distinct methylation class for papillary glioneuronal tumor, used diagnostically against a large reference cohort.
A mathematical model parameterized on clinical MGMT promoter methylation data from primary and recurrent glioblastoma is used to inform optimal temozolomide dosing, a treatment-selection application.

Chromatin immunoprecipitation and chromosome-conformation-capture assays showing SND1-driven chromatin topology changes are mechanistic experiments, while the 187 patient gliomas were assessed only by protein immunostaining, not by a direct chromatin assay.
Global DNA methylation is measured by a KASP-linked analysis in benzene-exposed shoe-factory workers versus unexposed controls, linking methylation to an occupational exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) is measured in cord blood and cord tissue of preterm versus full-term infants in a large birth cohort, identifying biomarkers of gestational age/prematurity.
GEO gene-expression and DNA-methylation data are integrated (secondary analysis of individual-level case-control data) to build blood-based Parkinson's disease classifiers.
Genome-wide 6-methyladenine DNA modification is measured by 6mA-IP-seq in PBMCs of SLE patients versus healthy controls, proposed as an early diagnostic marker.
MASPIN promoter methylation is measured by MSP and compared across cholelithiasis, gallbladder cancer, and control tissue, correlated with survival.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EWAS) is measured in the ALSPAC cohort and tested against multiple modifiable in-utero/postnatal exposures as a potential mediator of childhood ALL risk.
MST1/Hippo promoter methylation is measured by methylation-specific PCR in 223 patients from the MAPS phase 3 mesothelioma trial and evaluated for prognostic value.

Describes development of a novel single-base methylation quantification assay, technically validated against existing methods in only 10 colorectal cancer samples with no case-control clinical evaluation.
C8orf76 study measures gene amplification, lncRNA induction, and MAPK/ERK signaling via sequencing and reporter assays; no DNA methylation or histone modification is measured.
Single-center retrospective survival study of glioblastoma treatment evolution over two decades; no epigenetic marker is measured.
AHRR (cg05575921) leukocyte DNA methylation is measured in 465 lung cancer patients and tested for association with survival in a prospective cohort.

Promoter DNA methylation changes are listed among several multi-omic TCGA features correlated with radiomic imaging, but the abstract does not establish methylation itself as directly linked to a specific clinical decision rather than an incidental correlate.
Repressive H3K27me3 histone methylation is measured via EZH2 recruitment in postmortem human amygdala of early- versus late-onset alcohol-use-disorder cases and age-matched controls.
Study measures leukocyte telomere length, which is not one of the eligible epigenetic markers (DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or epigenetic clock).
MLH1 promoter hypermethylation is measured and used to subgroup mismatch-repair-deficient colorectal carcinomas, linked to prognosis and a fusion-screening strategy.
Gene-specific promoter DNA methylation of M1/M2 macrophage markers is measured by MS-HRM and compared between 25 coronary artery disease patients and 25 controls.
